user_decision.question: Phase 11.47's owed exists_rowLinked_path over Mrel is refuted as filed: Mrel carries P as a bare natural number with no hypothesis relating P+1 to the object, and at P+1 <= 2 the raised countdown threshold is met by the very tight pair the landed Srel refutation already kills (exists_rowLinked_path_over_Mrel_refuted, compiled; not_lnkRow_xR_yR carries no divisibility hypothesis). The refutation does NOT reach a (K1)-admissible modulus for R4, so the (K1)-restricted path forth is untouched and is the only direction left open. Repairing the signature adds a hypothesis beyond Mrel and the row budget, which the phase routes here rather than taking. How should the owed signature be repaired?
options: (R-1) Add the full (K1) condition `paramsOkK1 step pend lab phi P` as a hypothesis of exists_rowLinked_path and re-attempt items 2-4 over it. This is the condition the counter-quotient side already states, so the consumer of the path forth carries it anyway; it also drags in `lab` and `phi`, which the row-link layer is otherwise free of.

(R-2) Add only the object half of (K1) -- `forall l in objCycleLens step pend, l | (P + 1)` -- which is the conjunct the region-end agreement actually consumes and keeps the row-link layer free of `lab` and `phi`. Weaker than (R-1) and strictly cheaper, but it is a NEW condition rather than a named one, so the bridge to ParamsOk must be recorded.

(R-3) Refutation-first again at the repaired clip: before any construction, attempt to refute the path forth AT a (K1)-admissible modulus on R4 and on the branching object B5, since every prior round that adopted a relation without attacking it first lost that round. Costs one more round but matches the standing route discipline.

(R-4) Abandon the path-forth route for the untl clause and re-scope to what truth_iff_of_lnkRow plus exists_rowLinked_path_zero already cover, recording the row-level agreement as reachable only at budget (0,0).
user_decision.recommendation: (R-3), then (R-2). Three rounds (11.39 over Zrel, 11.41/11.42 over Srel, 11.44/11.45 over Mrel) each adopted a relation and then discovered it refuted; the one round that attacked first (11.44) is the one whose relation survived. (R-2) is the right target of that attack because objCycleLens is exactly the conjunct the region-end agreement consumes and it keeps the row-link layer free of the formula index -- but it should be attacked before it is adopted, not after.
